g.title: cluster_legend_state
g.text: a state: what it runs, top to bottom

g.title: f0__adjudicate__0
g.text: The blocked rows still waiting for a side — a row already adjudicated keeps its

g.title: f0__adjudicate__1
g.text: Mid-drain, reconcile the repair rows against doctor: close the open rows it no longer

g.title: f0__adjudicate__2
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__adjudicate__3
g.text: Read the other side: the story the node's code was last written to, and its text.

g.title: f0__adjudicate__4
g.text: adjudicate one blocked finding: which side is wrong?

g.title: f0__adjudicate__5
g.text: Route one verdict. Every branch writes the verdict and the chain on the row.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: Mid-drain, reconcile the repair rows against doctor: close the open rows it no longer

g.title: f0__adjudicate__5->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: rows still blocked after verdicts: operator gate

g.title: f0__select__0
g.text: Mid-drain, reconcile the repair rows against doctor: close the open rows it no longer

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__adjudicate__0
g.text: blocked rows and nothing pending: read the other side

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__0
g.text: Materialize a deterministic multi-language source inventory for OKF coverage.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: re-scan cap hit, coverage still incomplete: operator gate

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: findings unchanged for the stall cap: operator gate

g.title: f0__commit__0
g.text: Scan receipts and dispatch the next pending packet; iterate from a prepared scope.

g.title: f0__commit__1
g.text: Commit only the completed service book, with optional story provenance.

g.title: f0__commit__2
g.text: How many audit passes this run has opened; `advance` opens one more.

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: How many audit passes this run has opened; `advance` opens one more.

g.title: f0__commit__2->f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: current source/book lacks a clear audit receipt

g.title: f0__investigate__0
g.text: Commit whatever changed in the book, under `subject`; never fail the run.

g.title: f0__investigate__1
g.text: Stamp exactly the `@digest` targets this turn earned, gated by the turn's own errors.

g.title: f0__investigate__2
g.text: Replace `dest` with a copy of the book under `features_root`, as it stands now.

g.title: f0__record_item__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__investigate__2->f0__record_item__0
g.text: turn finished: record what it wrote

g.title: f0__seed_recheck__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__1
g.text: Compute the book's coverage — the verdict the agent used to emit.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__recheck__0
g.text: uncovered units: ask whether they are units

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__recheck__0
g.text: re-grounding rows all blocked: adjudicate the uncovered units

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: re-grounding rows all blocked and nothing uncovered: operator gate

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__select__0
g.text: cited source moved: re-ground those nodes

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: inventory cited: audit behavior in both directions

g.title: f0__retry_blocked__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__select__1
g.text: Pop the next pending item and mark it active.

g.title: f0__select__2
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f0__select__2->f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: the drain is dry: run doctor

g.title: f0__select__2->f0__refuel
g.text: item ceiling hit with work pending: ask for more

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__1
g.text: How many operator-answered audit gates this run has seen; per-run.

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__commit__0
g.text: audit clear: runtime walkthrough not requested

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__commit__0
g.text: audit partial by budget at the pass cap: commit with unaudited list

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: behavior repair attempts exhausted: operator gate

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__select__0
g.text: behavior gaps queued by source file or book node

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__select__0
g.text: unresolved behavior items queued at the bottom of the worklist

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: unresolved behavior or incomplete scope: operator gate

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: unresolved rows exhausted attempts: operator gate

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__walkthrough__0
g.text: audit clear: explicit runtime walkthrough requested

g.title: f0__semantic_audit__3->f0__walkthrough__0
g.text: audit partial by budget: walkthrough requested

g.title: f0__start->f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: empty book: same join seeds the worklist

g.title: f0__start->f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: the book exists: reconcile it to HEAD

g.title: f0__walkthrough__0->f0__commit__0
g.text: book complete: walked when there is an app

g.title: f0__walkthrough__0->f0__semantic_audit__0
g.text: runtime walkthrough disabled: audit current evidence

g.title: f1__start__0
g.text: Scan receipts and dispatch the next pending packet; iterate from a prepared scope.

g.title: f1__start__1
g.text: A staged repair packet, but only if it is still owed against *parent_digest*.

g.title: f1__start__2
g.text: Compute and persist the audit preparation once per run.

g.title: f1__start__3
g.text: Persist the typed raw reply before checking its exact IDs and reciprocal links.

g.title: f1__start__4
g.text: Keep invalid verdicts visible in the final report as well as the operator gate.

g.title: f1__start__5
g.text: Lay out the reduced packet a short reply left owing, or ``None`` if it salvaged nothing.

g.title: f1__start__6
g.text: Write the partial report a spent turn budget leaves: what was read, what was not.

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: receipt saved: rebuild scope before next packet

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: review contract changed: reassess under the current contract

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: incomplete receipt: ask again for the items still owed

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: invalid receipt: retry with validator findings

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: incomplete receipt, no further reduction: retry the pending work

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: transient CLI blip: same packet, separate budget

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: invalid verdict budget exhausted: operator gate

g.title: f1__start__7->f1__start__0
g.text: transient CLI streak exhausted: operator gate

g.title: f1__start__7->f1____end
g.text: selected packets assessed; limits in report

g.title: f1__start__7->f1____end
g.text: turn budget spent: unaudited packets listed in report

g.title: f2__start__0
g.text: Start the app under walk and wait for it to answer its health path.

g.title: f2__checkpoint__0
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f2__checkpoint__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f2__checkpoint__2
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f2__checkpoint__3
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f2__pick__0
g.text: Pop the next pending item and mark it active.

g.title: f2__mark__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f2__pick__1
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f2__pick__2
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f2__walk__0
g.text: walk one WEB journey against the LIVE app

g.title: f2__start__1
g.text: Own the shared CDP browser's lifecycle.

g.title: f2__start__2
g.text: Seed the walk worklist with the *unconfirmed* delta.

g.title: f2__start__3
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f2__start__4
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f2__start__4->f2__pick__0
g.text: app and browser up: walk seeded

g.title: f2__start__4->f2____end
g.text: no screen surfaces: nothing to walk

g.title: f2__start__4->f2____end
g.text: the app would not come up

g.title: legend_c->legend_d
g.text: await: parked on an operator gate

g.title: legend_handoff
g.text: run to its END, then back here
